caveats: All volumes are model estimates (`model_estimate`); `observed=false` and `policy_grade=false`.
The 119 Mm3 case is a planning allocation, not a legal AAC, a sustainable-supply determination, or an observed harvest outcome. No legal/AAC claim is made.
Capacity is mixed-basis: 2015 Mills DB/FFCM infeed proxies, converted 2025 pellet-map finished-pellet bulk volume, and BC class-median proxies. The bases are not interchangeable.
Converted pellet capacity is finished-product volume, not infeed-equivalent; no pellet yield, moisture, bark, grade, or recovery conversion is modelled.
New pellet facilities without a plant-gate coordinate use city centroids; their distance-based assignment carries location uncertainty.
The allocation is local-first with a 500 km cross-border penalty. Cross-border volume is a screening result, not an interprovincial trade forecast.
The 1.2x provincial floor is a documented sensitivity assumption, not an observed capacity requirement or evidence of provincial self-sufficiency.
No unbounded facility exists in v4: every assignment row carries a finite capacity and every relevant record has either published or proxy capacity.
No restricted or proprietary data are used. No UI or public OSeCAN surface is changed by this artifact.

capacity_evidence.proxy: BC class median from published infeed-proxy records; converted pellet volumes excluded from the anchor
capacity_evidence.published_converted: 2025 Canadian Biomass pellet-map finished tonnes/yr converted at 650 kg/m3 to finished-pellet bulk volume

method.distance_basis: haversine from ADM1 polygon centroid to facility coordinate; road distance = haversine * road factor
method.no_unbounded_facility: every assignment row carries a finite capacity; no facility can absorb unlimited volume
method.quantity_basis: province harvest_m3 treated one-to-one as facility infeed m3; no moisture, bark, grade, or recovery conversion

scenarios.province_capacity_floor: v3 1.2x harvest-floor sensitivity; proxies only are scaled, published capacity is never altered
scenarios.published_only: only published-capacity facilities are eligible; includes converted 2025 pellet-map capacities
scenarios.published_plus_proxy: published plus BC class-median proxy capacity; primary updated-evidence run

method.supply_offers: one ungraded provincial offer per province
method.unlocated_capacity: excluded from the spatial screen and reported separately
